experiment_title: H3 video to editable motion - overnight round 1
summary: Completed H3 recovery and controlled comparisons, with known-motion references and explicit failed-quality candidates. Job completion is separate from visual acceptance.

tests.title: K0 known-motion recovery control
tests.description: Recover the original 3.2-second K0 Pounce plus a 0.8-second hold from exact front/side renders. Compare recovered bones against retained ground truth and inspect from a new camera.
limitations: Native shoulder translation up to 10.6 mm is outside the rotation-only fitter contract.
An exact-camera synthetic control is easier than recovering generated H3 imagery.
Valid serialization does not establish plausible contact, weight or balance.
Root motion is fitted on LUMBAR; game root extraction needs deliberate mapping.

limitations: Out of distribution: a stylized robot, not a human performer.

A plausible human skeleton does not validate the unseen robot anatomy.

tests.title: C07 jump - approximate-body stress test
tests.description: Try a bounded recovery test using the available published C07 rig. Its appearance and silhouette differ substantially from H3 frame0; the exact generation mesh is not verified.
limitations: Available C07 body differs from H3 frame0, beyond camera/pose differences; this violates the ideal exact-character input assumption.
Camera and starting pose are approximate.
A poor fit cannot be attributed to training or solver quality alone.
Valid serialization does not establish plausible contact, weight or balance.
Root motion is fitted on LUMBAR; game root extraction needs deliberate mapping.
The available C07 rig differs visibly from the H3 reference. This is an approximate-body negative control, not a verified exact-character reconstruction.

tests.title: Concept video to C08 - adapter stress test
tests.description: Apply the existing direct SOMA-to-C08 adapter to the concept robot recovery. This tests a complete video-to-different-body route and exposes adapter corrections.
limitations: Human estimator applied outside its normal distribution.
No original concept robot rig; C08 is a different body.
Existing adapter applies per-frame whole-avatar grounding, with corrections up to0.518m: weight/vertical motion are altered.
120Hz skin sampling finds a7.2mm floor penetration between keys despite15mm margin at baked keys.
Rest-pose fingers, no contact locking or physical balance solve.
A numerical/export pass is not motion approval.
Recovered root is not cyclic: estimated end-to-start horizontal gap about5.88m. No seamless game loop is claimed.
notes: Computed, visually unreviewed. Treat as a diagnostic candidate; do not accept automatically because the file validates.
